column1: # Named column-projection views (MDD 11.3) with row windows.
# Measured on this book (sheetty pack, 2026-09-29): the evidence sheets are far
# larger than any single context window. Unwindowed they cost, in estimated
#   re/methods   14,052 rows  ~379,526 tok    <- 1.9x a 200k window on its own
# So a whole evidence sheet is not a usable context unit, which is MDD open
# question Q6. The MDD's prescribed fix is a row window rather than a smaller
# sheet, "because splitting the sheet would break the key space". That is what
# `row_window` is: `*` for all rows, or `A..B` inclusive, 1-based.
# A budget is what I am willing to spend; a window is what makes that possible.
